import sys
n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
if n % 2 == 0:
    print("Second")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    pairs = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
    chosen = []
    used_pairs = set()
    for i in range(2 * n):
        if pairs[i] not in used_pairs:
            chosen.append(i + 1)
            used_pairs.add(pairs[i])
    print(" ".join(map(str, chosen)))
    sys.stdout.flush()
else:
    print("First")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    pairs = []
    current_pair = 1
    for i in range(2 * n):
        pairs.append(current_pair)
        if (i + 1) % 2 == 0:
            current_pair += 1
    print(" ".join(map(str, pairs)))
    sys.stdout.flush()
